svg.title: About
svg.desc: For three years I was the person on the other end of the ticket: triaging fifty incidents a day, administering Active Directory and keeping SLAs green for enterprise clients. Near the end I built a Python tool that used a language model to turn prose access requests into concrete directory changes, and I approved every one. That tool is where AI stopped being a subject and became the work. Now I'm doing an MSc in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science at Northeastern University London. My dissertation tests guardrails for LLM agents: if a rule blocks one large refund, does the agent split it into many small ones that each pass? I'm open to AI and ML internships, including summer 2027 or a placement that counts toward the MSc, and to full-time roles from February 2027.
